    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Address
    )

    # Regex breakdown:
    # ^ and $ : Start and end of string

    $pattern = "^$octet\.$octet\.$octet\.$octet$"

    if ($Address -match $pattern) {
        return $true
    }
    return $false
}

function Test-IPv4 {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Address
    )

    # Regex breakdown:
    # ^ and $ : Start and end of string
    # (?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3} : Matches first 3 octets + dot
    #     25[0-5]          -> 250-255
    #     2[0-4][0-9]      -> 200-249
    #     [01]?[0-9][0-9]? -> 0-199 (handles 0-9, 00-99, 100-199)
    # However, to strictly forbid leading zeros (e.g., "01"), we refine the octet pattern:
    # (25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])
    
    $pattern = '^(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])$'

    if ($Address -match $pattern) {
        return $true
    }
    return $false
}
